thought.text: The verification passed (correct title from both dev server and static export) but the pkill matched the shell itself. Let me confirm the dev server is stopped:

reasoning_content:
The command was forcibly terminated (exit code 143). This is because `pkill -f "next dev"` killed the shell process itself (the shell's command line contains "next dev"). However, the important verification results have already been obtained:
- `<title>EAM Portal Bund - Enterprise Architecture Management</title>` — the page title is correct
- `grep -c '<title>' /workspace/out/index.html` → 1 (the static export contains the page)

Let's check whether the dev server was properly stopped, and whether the port has been released.

action.command: ps aux | grep -E "next|node" | grep -v grep; code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 3 http://localhost:3000/ 2>/dev/null); echo "port check: $code"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "ps aux | grep -E \"next|node\" | grep -v grep; code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w \"%{http_code}\" --max-time 3 http://localhost:3000/ 2>/dev/null); echo \"port check: $code\"", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Confirm dev server processes stopped"}
